# Keyboard shortcuts

Default shortcuts. Linux uses the Windows column, with `Super` in place of `Win`. A command can have several shortcuts; two-stroke chords are pressed one after the other. Change them in [Keybindings](../keybindings.md).

## File

| Command | macOS | Windows / Linux | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| Close | `⌘W` | `Ctrl+W` |  |
| Delete | `Delete`, `⌘⌫` | `Delete`, `Ctrl+Backspace` | `explorerFocus`, `explorerFocus` |
| New File | `⌘N` | `Ctrl+N` |  |
| New Scratchpad | `⌥⌘N` | `Ctrl+Alt+N` |  |
| New Window | `⇧⌘N` | `Ctrl+Shift+N` |  |
| Open File… | `⌘O` | `Ctrl+O` |  |
| Open Workspace… | `⌘K ⌘O` | `Ctrl+K Ctrl+O` |  |
| Quit Notoir | `⌘Q` | `Ctrl+Q` |  |
| Rename… | `F2` | `F2` | `explorerFocus` |
| Save | `⌘S` | `Ctrl+S` |  |
| Save All | `⌥⌘S` | `Ctrl+Alt+S` |  |
| Save As… | `⇧⌘S` | `Ctrl+Shift+S` |  |

## Edit

| Command | macOS | Windows / Linux | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| Delete Line | `⇧⌘K` | `Ctrl+Shift+K` |  |
| Duplicate Line | `⇧⌘D` | `Ctrl+Shift+D` |  |
| Find | `⌘F` | `Ctrl+F` |  |
| Find Next | `⌘G` | `F3` |  |
| Find Previous | `⇧⌘G` | `Shift+F3` |  |
| Insert Line Above | `⇧⌘↩` | `Ctrl+Shift+Enter` |  |
| Insert Line Below | `⌘↩` | `Ctrl+Enter` |  |
| Move Line Down | `⌥↓` | `Alt+Down` |  |
| Move Line Up | `⌥↑` | `Alt+Up` |  |
| Redo | `⇧⌘Z` | `Ctrl+Shift+Z`, `Ctrl+Y` |  |
| Replace | `⌥⌘F` | `Ctrl+H` |  |
| Search in Workspace | `⇧⌘F` | `Ctrl+Shift+F` |  |
| Select All | `⌘A` | `Ctrl+A` | `editorFocus` |
| Undo | `⌘Z` | `Ctrl+Z` |  |

## Selection

| Command | macOS | Windows / Linux | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| Add Cursor Above | `⌥⌘↑` | `Ctrl+Alt+Up` | `editorFocus` |
| Add Cursor Below | `⌥⌘↓` | `Ctrl+Alt+Down` | `editorFocus` |
| Add Next Occurrence | `⌘D` | `Ctrl+D` | `editorFocus` |
| Expand Selection | `⌃⇧⌘→` | `Alt+Shift+Right` | `editorFocus` |
| Select All Occurrences | `⇧⌘L` | `Ctrl+Shift+L` | `editorFocus` |
| Shrink Selection | `⌃⇧⌘←` | `Alt+Shift+Left` | `editorFocus` |
